description.zh: 资源类型。多个资源类型之间用半角逗号（,）分隔。
description.en: The types of the resources that you want Cloud Config to monitor. Separate multiple resource types with commas (,).

title.zh: 修改监控中的资源类型

descriptions.zh: 该接口仅对当前请求的阿里云账号有效。关于配置审计支持的资源类型，请参见[支持配置审计的云服务](~~127411~~)。
descriptions.en: This operation is valid only for the current Alibaba Cloud account. For more information, see [Alibaba Cloud services that support Cloud Config](~~127411~~).
